title: The Treasure Hunters
moral: Courage and teamwork lead to great discoveries.

scenes.summary: Jack and his friends plan to find hidden treasure.
scenes.text: Jack heard about a hidden treasure and decided to explore an abandoned village with his friends.
scenes.image_prompt: kids preparing for treasure hunt in village, bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: They enter a mysterious maze filled with puzzles.
scenes.text: They found a maze at the village entrance and had to solve puzzles to move forward.
scenes.image_prompt: kids solving puzzles in maze with vines and stones, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They work together to solve challenges.
scenes.text: Each friend used their skills to solve riddles and overcome obstacles in the maze.
scenes.image_prompt: team of kids solving riddles together, cheerful cartoon scene

scenes.text: They reached the center and found a treasure chest full of jewels and artifacts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids opening treasure chest glowing with gems, magical cartoon

scenes.summary: They return home with pride and happiness.
scenes.text: They returned home happily, proud of their courage and teamwork.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking back home smiling at sunset, warm cartoon style

story: Jack heard about a hidden treasure in an abandoned village and set off with his friends Lily, Oliver, and Mia. They entered a maze and solved puzzles using teamwork. Each friend helped overcome challenges along the way. Finally, they found a treasure chest filled with jewels and artifacts. They returned home happy and proud, knowing their courage and teamwork led them to success.
